claim: The substrate's operating credit is read from what it MEANT against what the world DID — and where nothing was operated, nothing is credited.
hypothesis: If meant-vs-happened supplies operating correctness, then a reached aim credits a win from the reconciled intent, an unrealized aim credits a loss even when every step confirmed, and a goal that never planned moves the posterior not at all.

metrics.name: reached_runs_accepted_as_complete
metrics.note: the substrate's own belief that the goal holds; 0/5 before the driven-plan path had a world grounding

metrics.name: earned_if_never_operated_counted
metrics.note: the same record with the two unplannable goals credited as losses, which is what happened before this change

checks.label: outcomes that establish nothing about operating are DENIED credit
a denied outcome does not even enter the DENOMINATOR
checks.detail: attempts=0 wins=0 after 5 denied outcome(s) — counting them as attempts would dilute earned reliability

checks.label: an UNCLASSIFIED outcome is denied (a caller that forgets loses the data point loudly rather than teaching a false one)
eligible outcomes DO move the posterior (the invariant is not a wall)
the MOVE_FILE operator is held, or taught
the planner declined honestly and the deficit was diagnosed
NO operating outcome recorded for work that was never operated
checks.detail: attempts 2→2, wins 2→2 — a knowledge deficit is not an operating failure

checks.label: the verdict names WHY it is not evidence about operating
every drive really moved the file (the filesystem is the oracle)
each realized aim credited exactly one operating WIN
the win is read from the BELIEF, grounded in the reconciled intent
checks.detail: read_from=completion belief, grounded in the reconciled intent

checks.label: the substrate BELIEVES it did what it meant — the completion belief reaches done for a multi-step plan (measured 0/5 before the plan path had a world grounding)
the belief was moved by a FRESH re-observation of what the plan MEANT (its goal conditions), independent of the act's own report
every step's own runtime evidence CONFIRMED
the AIM was still not realized, and only meant-vs-happened says so
the miss credited an operating LOSS (attempt counted, no win)
the loss is read from the BELIEF, grounded in the reconciled intent
checks.detail: read_from=completion belief, grounded in the reconciled intent success=False

checks.label: the substrate does NOT believe it did what it meant — the fresh world grounding is evidence AGAINST the goal
no operator was taught anything by this miss (statuses unchanged)
a HIGH completion posterior does NOT turn an unrealized aim into a win — the conflict is denied, not resolved in favour of either
checks.detail: read_from=belief and the reconciled intent disagree class=indeterminate

checks.label: and the mirror: a LOW posterior does not turn a realized aim into a loss
checks.detail: read_from=belief and the reconciled intent disagree

checks.label: the guard is not swallowing the real runs — belief and world AGREED on every drive this experiment made
checks.detail: 5/5 realized aims believed done, miss believed done: False

checks.label: earned reliability is computed from the credited outcomes only
crediting the never-operated goals would have LOWERED earned reliability on work the substrate never did
checks.detail: earned=0.5291 vs 0.3968 had the two unplannable goals counted as operating failures

checks.label: the KNOW→DO bar moved with it, by the bar's own rule
the planner's DECLARED input carries the corrected number, from the domain authority
